So if `u8ProtectionMode` is neither 0 nor 1, szFieldSummary isn't initialized at all.
The bitmask for this field is given as `0x01` in the field definition, so presumably that should be used here as well.
You are right. I should have masked `u8ProtectionMode ` with `0x01`. But I see you already did it with [19890](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19890). Thanks for the update.

```suggestion:-0+0
extract_pnio_objects_withoutAR(pinfo);
```
Hi, in the PNIO class 1 frame ID range (0x8000 to 0xbbff), the function `extract_pnio_objects_withoutAR()` is called, but it isn't used for the multicast frame ID range. Is there a specific reason why it's not called for multicast packets as well?
